args.title: Fix off-by-one error in paginate: end index was including extra item
args.body:
## Problem
The `page()` function in `src/paginate.py` computed the end index as `start + size + 1`, causing it to return one extra item beyond the requested page size. For example, page 2 of a 10-item list with size 3 returned 4 items instead of 3.

## Root Cause
Line 3 had an off-by-one bug:
```python
end = start + size + 1  # BUG: off by one
```

## Fix
Removed the erroneous `+ 1`:
```python
end = start + size
```

## Testing
The existing test `tests/test_paginate.py::test_page_size_is_exact` now passes, confirming that page slices are exactly `size` items long.
